acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent semi-circular notch is visible on the posterior margin of the upper caudal lobe. The distal tip of the upper lobe exhibits a jagged, irregular margin consistent with tissue loss. Minor irregular indentations are also present on the trailing edge of the lower lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin surface displays a pattern of high-luminance, roughly circular spots of varying radii. These spots are most densely clustered near the anterior base of the upper lobe and become increasingly sparse toward the posterior margins.
